P takes the only seat left.
Final arrangement, clockwise from K: K, Q, R, P, S, N, M, T, J, L.
N faces the centre, so N's right runs anticlockwise and left runs clockwise.
From N, going to N's right: S — **Immediate right**.
solution.shortcut: Stand in the seat of the second person, face where they face, and count.
solution.trap: Immediate left is what you get by taking left/right from your own view instead of N's.
